author: GamingBolt
description:
In the second part of our recap of the entire Gears of War franchise, we covered the events of Gears: Tactics. Here in part 3, we're going to move on to events of Gears of War 3: RAAM's Shadow and Gears of War 1.

Humanity on Sera was no stranger to the ground shaking. Engaged for decades in the Pendulum Wars, fighting each other for Imulsion, war was a constant – an unshakeable part of daily life. That is, until it ended in the Year 0 B.E. The Union of Independent Republics, having lost blueprints for a superweapon known as the Dawn of War, surrendered to the Coalition of Governments or COG. Sera was united amid ruins and millions dead, but it was finally time to rebuild and leave all that behind.
title: The Complete Story of Gears of War 1 - Before You Play Gears of War E-Day (Part 3)

author: GamingBolt
description:
Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown gave the long-running flight series a modern revival, introducing new players to its accessible arcade dogfighting, cinematic storytelling, and huge aerial battles. 

Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve retains the formula while introducing some significant changes, from first-person storytelling and squadron commands to newly reactive missions and a vastly expanded suite of multiplayer modes. Here are fifteen of the biggest ways Wings of Theve differs from its predecessor.
title: Ace Combat 8 vs Ace Combat 7 - 15 Biggest Differences You Absolutely Need To Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
It could be easy to assume that The Witcher 3 Remastered is the culmination of years of loving work on a title that holds a special place in the hearts of those who made it. On its own, that would be enough to make it quite appealing to fans of Geralt’s sprawling adventure, and that’s not even accounting for the many amazing changes it’s bringing to The Continent.

But what if there’s more to the story than that?
title: Why The Witcher 3 Remastered Matters More for The Witcher 4 Than It Seems
